steps.what: Advise parents about childhood immunizations, check understanding and explain how to access services

tasks.design: Keep explanation and discussion with the worker using existing approved information in {DOCS}. No individual vaccine recommendation, automated eligibility decision or shorter conversation is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Parents need clear explanations and space to ask questions.
tasks.enabler_now: Case-note tools do not replace understanding or trust.
tasks.still_hard: Individual clinical questions need the appropriate qualified service.
tasks.human_edge: The worker listens to concerns and checks what the parent has understood.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in advisory time or clinical authority.

evidence.claim: Parental explanation and service navigation remain personal work; no separate drafting workload is presumed.

assumptions: Boundary is explanation and access navigation, excluding vaccination, clinical eligibility and programme policy.
Health programme staff supply existing approved information and service contacts upstream with unchanged effort. No machine step requires structured child-health data.
No new implementation or upkeep is introduced; incremental hours are zero.
unknowns: Approved materials, languages and referral contacts
research_questions: Which concerns require referral to a qualified immunisation professional?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 and zero upkeep; the personal conversation remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collect and compile community health statistics

steps.what: Collect individuals' health information and resolve missing or unclear responses
Compile verified records into the required community health counts and tables
Check totals, missing responses and disclosure limits before accepting the statistics

tasks.design: Configure {SPREADSHEET} tables and fixed validation rules to compile already captured questionnaire records. The worker keeps all individual collection and clarification time and checks counts, denominators and disclosure limits before handing statistics to the analyst.
tasks.previous_blocker: Verified responses are manually tallied into repeated tables.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas and pivot tables can apply explicit counting definitions.
tasks.still_hard: Missing responses, duplicate participants and small groups can make totals misleading or identifying.
tasks.human_edge: The worker understands collection limitations and follows up ambiguous responses.
tasks.altitude: Less manual tallying; no new authority to infer health status or publish identifiable data.

evidence.claim: Fixed tabulation of verified survey records is plausible without a model; no digest product or case establishes this task's labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary is worker collection, tabulation and internal acceptance, excluding clinical diagnosis, research design and analyst interpretation.

The worker produces record ID, collection date, questionnaire version, question ID, coded response and missing-response reason in s1's retained 55 hours, including transcription from paper where needed. Programme staff supply existing question definitions upstream unchanged; extra definition upkeep is counted below. Ambiguous responses remain manual and are not inferred.
Try native tables and validation before custom code; existing automatic tabulation earns no saving. No new collection fields are required beyond the authorised questionnaire.
unknowns: Questionnaire definitions and lawful data access
research_questions: Do native tables reproduce an independently checked sample including missing and duplicate responses?

incremental.description: Maintain formulas and check questionnaire-version changes
Programme analyst maintains counting and disclosure definitions

approvals.approved_version: Exact record snapshot, questionnaire version, counting rules and statistics table version; edits void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=70; gross 30 less 4 focal upkeep gives net 26. Two other-role upkeep hours are excluded from focal savings. Low is already automatic tabulation with no rollout; high requires 30 hours of real manual tallying and unchanged capture.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interpret health information and mediate cultural understanding

steps.what: Interpret or translate health information and mediate cultural meaning during community members' exchanges

tasks.design: Keep live interpretation and cultural mediation with a competent person. Existing approved materials in {DOCS} can support the exchange, but no unattended translation or generated cultural inference is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Words, intent and cultural expectations must be understood together.
tasks.enabler_now: Case-note drafting does not establish reliable live cultural mediation.
tasks.still_hard: Dialect, ambiguity and sensitive meanings require clarification with the speakers.
tasks.human_edge: The worker recognises misunderstanding and checks meaning directly with both parties.
tasks.altitude: No change in mediation time or interpretation responsibilities.

evidence.claim: Live cultural mediation remains human work; no separate written-translation production baseline is inferred.

assumptions: Boundary is live interpretation and mediation, excluding independently commissioned written translation and clinical decisions.
Speakers produce their statements during the retained exchange; no structured cultural attributes or risk labels are assumed.
No new system or upkeep is introduced; incremental hours are zero.
unknowns: Languages, dialects and required interpreter qualifications
research_questions: Which exchanges require a separately qualified interpreter?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 and zero upkeep; unchanged interpretation and cultural mediation yields zero saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeated statistical tallying while protecting collection time, parental explanations and cultural mediation.
reach: Help health educators interpret community-data limitations
Support healthcare social workers with cultural communication
role.ambitious_version: A community worker who spends less time tallying and keeps direct attention on people's understanding and circumstances.
